Job description:
Responsibilities include designing and improving prompts and output structures for model quality, accuracy, and stability, focusing on scenarios involving laboratory data analysis. This involves designing and enhancing evaluation frameworks with test datasets, metrics, and regression tests, and improving RAG pipelines (retrieval, re-ranking, document management, and source attribution quality). Selecting and comparing models based on Persian response quality, cost, latency, and on-premise deployment feasibility. Managing clinical risks: reducing hallucination, grounding responses, defining response boundaries, optimizing cost and token consumption, and adding observability (Logging/Tracing) to model interactions. Collaborating with the product development team (.NET and Angular) for integration and improving user experience. Required skills include hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based products in real environments (not just experimental samples). Deep understanding of popular language models (GPT family, Claude, Gemini, and open models like Llama, Qwen, Mistral) and their differences in quality, cost, context window, and Persian support. Proficiency in Prompt Engineering, Structured Output, Function Calling, and multi-turn conversation management. Experience designing and optimizing RAG systems (Vector Databases, Embedding models, Chunking strategies, retrieval evaluation). Experience building evaluation systems for LLM outputs (Golden Datasets, LLM-as-Judge, accuracy and coverage metrics). Experience working with Decision Support systems, preferably in the health or sensitive data domain. Proficiency in Python and practical familiarity with C# / .NET. Ability to analyze problems, document technical decisions, and provide understandable reports for non-technical teams. Desirable skills include familiarity with medical diagnostic lab concepts (reference limits, critical values, interpretation of laboratory profiles). Experience deploying open models locally (vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp) and Fine-tuning/LoRA. Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tools (Langfuse, Ragas, Promptfoo). Experience working with Semantic Kernel or Microsoft.Extensions.AI. Familiarity with HL7 / LOINC standards and considerations for medical data privacy. Experience using AI tools for software development (Cursor, Claude Code). Personal attributes include a critical view of model output and prioritizing clinical safety over superficial appeal. Ability to convert vague feedback from domain experts into measurable metrics. Scientific mindset and documentation of results. Working conditions: Full-time, in-person, minimum 2 years of direct experience in LLM/NLP projects. Compensation: Negotiable based on skill level + insurance. Company location: Second district, Sadoghieh.

Company description:
The Peyvand Tab and Software company started its work in 1377 by presenting the first version of the medical laboratory management software. Then over time, gradually, along with the release of different versions of the testing software and the significant improvement of the system's features and capabilities, the range of this company's products also expanded, and products for managing pharmacies, radiology centers, clinics, and hospitals were also produced and entered the market.
